payload.reason: The evidence provides specific references to previous works that are compared to the current research, particularly in the context of morphological information in translation models.

claims.text: Previous work considered morphological information for both SMT and NMT, including methods that integrate word-level annotation and utilize morphological features on both source and target sides.
BIBREF8 proposed an effective way to integrate word-level annotation in SMT, while BIBREF11 enhanced encoding in NMT using various source side features.

The current work is the first to explicitly consider the generation of morphological suffixes within a neural translation model, motivated by previous works that generate morphology during text generation.
